sql:
WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY league_id, home_team_api_id
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY league_id, away_team_api_id
),
combined_wins AS (
    SELECT league_id, team_api_id, wins as total_wins FROM home_wins
    UNION ALL
    SELECT league_id, team_api_id, wins as total_wins FROM away_wins
),
total_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(total_wins) as total_wins
    FROM combined_wins
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
),
team_wins_with_name AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        tw.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        tw.total_wins
    FROM total_wins tw
    JOIN Team t ON tw.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
)
SELECT league_id, team_name, total_wins
FROM team_wins_with_name
WHERE total_wins = 0
ORDER BY league_id
LIMIT 20
